confederation.qualification_summary: UEFA qualifying used a first-round group stage of twelve groups, followed by four single-leg play-off paths. Each group winner qualified directly for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The twelve group runners-up and four best eligible 2024-25 UEFA Nations League group winners entered the play-offs, where each path winner qualified.

rounds.description: Twelve groups: six groups of four and six groups of five. Teams played home-and-away. Group winners qualified directly; group runners-up advanced to play-offs; four Nations League group winners outside the top two also advanced.
Sixteen teams entered four single-leg play-off paths. Each path had two semi-finals and one final. The four final winners qualified for the World Cup.
